author: voidloop
body:
Hi,

I have a question.


Who is in charge of Screenshares, and is there a set amount of people that get trained in order to be able to Screenshare? 

Also, can these people detect known clients such as Cracked/Payed Vape or Spook?


Thanks.

title: Regarding SS

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Tazz and Posighdun are in charge of screenshares. We are about to release the screenshare guide, in which a lot more people other than a select few will be able to screenshare. There won't be a set number though.

Yes, we know how to detect cracked and paid Vape, but Spook isn't even 1.8.

- Tazz
